name: Force Update
route: No live route — system-level full-screen gate above every authorized/unauthorized route, incl. the tab shell
annotation: A single, unskippable system gate: one hero moment (icon cluster + title) forces the update, with quiet What's-new evidence and honest version metadata below, and one glowing CTA. No nav, no exit, no negotiation.
trustControls: ChipProvenance: "via server release notes" under the What's new list
ChipProvenance: "via device build config" beside the version string
VoiceOver/TalkBack label "Update required" on the badge glyph (app icon marked decorative)
aria-live="polite" region announces Error / Loading / Offline / Android-back-press toasts
notes: Conditional states not shown as default modules: OfflineBanner (glass-pill strip under the status bar, no back chevron) reads "You're offline - update when you reconnect," CTA stays tappable. SystemGateOverlay wrapper: full-bleed, opaque, no scrim, mounts above the tab shell, consumes edge-swipe-back (iOS) and hardware back (Android); repeated Android back-press resurfaces the supportive toast rather than doing nothing. Entrance: staggered ~1.0s — screen fade, then wordmark, then icon scale-in, then badge spring-in, then title/subtitle cascade; nothing animates before the screen is legible. Reduced motion: entrance choreography and the CTA glow-breathe collapse to end state instantly (CANON 6). Disabled state is N/A by design — CTA always accepts retry (CANON 8 no-dead-end rule for a mandatory gate). Success: app backgrounds when the store opens; if the user returns without updating, CTA silently resets to its default label, no lecture, no re-triggered animation. Haptics: medium impact on CTA tap; triple-pulse error haptic on failed store hand-off.

modules.build: Standard iOS status bar, dark shell: time left, signal/wifi/battery right, paper-100 icons on #0A0A0F. No notch overlay, no back chevron — this screen has no secondary exit.

"Balencia." wordmark, static Chillax brand asset (not Neue Montreal), 20px, +0.02em tracking, paper-100 at 82% opacity, centered. Deliberately small — the Display title below is the one hero moment; wordmark must not compete.

NEW LockShieldCluster: native app icon 96x96 (OS squircle mask, unstyled product asset) centered, with a 32px .glass-pill badge overlapping bottom-right (6/6 offset) holding a 20px rounded-2px-outline update-arrow glyph, orange #FF5E00 tint only, no glow/blur. VoiceOver label: "Update required."
Display 34, NM Medium, centered, paper-100: "An important security update is available." The screen's single Display moment — visually singular, dominant focal point, not one tile among many.

Body-light, paper-64%, centered, max-width 327px, 2-line: "This update includes important security improvements to keep your data *safe*." One Newsreader Medium Italic emphasis word: "safe" — the screen's only italic moment.

GlassCard (default, non-interactive, r28, 24px pad). Overline stored as "What's new" (rendered uppercase). Plain outline-dot bullets: "Faster CIA coaching responses", "New workout plans and exercises", "Bug fixes and performance improvements." ChipProvenance caption: "via server release notes." Fetch: SkeletonState shimmer over real geometry. Empty: card collapses to 0pt, no filler text.

BtnPrimary "Update now" — solid #FF5E00 fill (never glass-pill), r999, h52, full-width, external --glow-you halo (32px radial blur) breathing behind it, the screen's sole focal lantern. Error: label becomes "Try again" + glass-pill toast above reads "Couldn't open the store - check your connection." Deep-link tap: width locks, spinner replaces label, toast "Opening the store."

Caption, tabular-nums, centered: "v2.1.0 -> v3.0.0 required" beside ChipProvenance "via device build config." Honest-null fallback if remote config fails to parse a minimum version before timeout: unversioned string "Update required" — never a broken half-populated comparison.
